title: nginx is running but 'localhost' can't reach it -- wrong bind address
description_md:
The web app is supposed to answer on `http://localhost:8080/` (i.e. `127.0.0.1:8080`). Health checks all fail with connection refused, but the nginx process is definitely running and definitely holding port 8080 open -- `ss` proves it. Someone pinned the bind address to the wrong local address during a redeploy. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), find the mismatch, and fix it.

You're done when `curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/` (equivalently `http://localhost:8080/`) succeeds.
